description: Warning-only shape checks for the pinned browser SDK POST /rec/page on its default recorder host. The actual transport is text/plain containing JSON. Scrubbed and omitted privacy fields, empty key hashes and optional identity fields are preserved. Bundle encoding, custom hosts, session validity and receiver rejection policy remain external.

params.name: body.OrgId
params.description: Initialization requires a configured organization string. Only producer completeness is checked, without issued-ID grammar.

params.name: body.CompiledVersion
params.description: The producer emits its build string; no fixed hash or version value is imposed.

params.name: body.CompiledTimestamp
params.description: The producer emits its numeric build timestamp. No runtime clock or age bounds are inferred.

params.name: body.SessionKeyHash
params.description: The source initializes this field to an empty string. Empty is valid and no hash grammar is imposed.

params.name: body.PageKeyHash
params.description: The source initializes this field to an empty string. Empty is valid and no hash grammar is imposed.

params.name: body.Url
params.description: Privacy scrubbing can omit or empty this field. No URL scheme, nonempty value or receiver requirement is inferred.

params.name: body.Base
params.description: Privacy scrubbing can omit or empty this field. No URL scheme, nonempty value or receiver requirement is inferred.

params.name: body.Referrer
params.description: Privacy scrubbing can omit or empty this field. No URL scheme, nonempty value or receiver requirement is inferred.

params.name: body.Width
params.description: Optional source numeric metadata. No sign, size, integer or clock bounds are imposed.

params.name: body.Height
params.description: Optional source numeric metadata. No sign, size, integer or clock bounds are imposed.

params.name: body.ScreenWidth
params.description: Optional source numeric metadata. No sign, size, integer or clock bounds are imposed.

params.name: body.ScreenHeight
params.description: Optional source numeric metadata. No sign, size, integer or clock bounds are imposed.

params.name: body.PreviewMode
params.description: The source omits false preview mode; true is emitted when enabled. Absence remains valid.

params.name: body.UserId
params.description: Source runtime value is opaque and may be omitted. No identifier alphabet or native type is imposed.
